name: ITG, Inc.
summary: ITG, Inc. provides services to the digital and other utility infrastructure industries in the United States. It delivers technology-enabled, end-to-end services supporting the planning, design, construction, operation, maintenance, and expansion of broadband networks. The company offers engineering and maintenance services, such as developing new routes, the placement and installation of fiber cables, and supporting infrastructure from main distribution lines to end users' homes or businesses, as well as troubleshooting service calls.
